title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description:
s has only uppercase letters A to Z. You may change at most k characters into any other letter. Return the length of the longest run of one repeated letter you can make.

s = "AABABBA", k = 1 → 4 (change the middle A to B: "AABBBBA")
tracePrompt: Trace of "AABABBA", k = 1: one row per character that comes into the window

tests.name: Best letter changes along the way
